hlotimizacao.tela.ajustes: What can be adjusted (nothing is changed automatically)
hlotimizacao.tela.ajuste_entidades: Entity distance %s%% with %s entities loaded: try 75–100%%
hlotimizacao.tela.ajuste_entidades_dica: Options > Video Settings > Entity Distance. Above 100%, mobs are drawn further away than vanilla; with crowds in view, every model drawn costs FPS.
hlotimizacao.tela.ajuste_biomas: Biome blend %s with integrated graphics: try OFF
hlotimizacao.tela.ajuste_biomas_dica: Options > Video Settings > Biome Blend. Blending colors makes chunk rebuilds heavier, and %s shares the CPU and RAM.
hlotimizacao.tela.ajuste_distancia: Render distance %s with integrated graphics: try 8
hlotimizacao.tela.ajuste_distancia_dica: Each extra ring of chunks is more geometry to rebuild and draw on a GPU that shares the system RAM.
hlotimizacao.tela.ajuste_chunky: Pre-generate the world with Chunky (already installed)
hlotimizacao.tela.ajuste_chunky_dica: Generating new chunks while exploring competes with rendering for the CPU. Run /chunky radius 3000 and then /chunky start (about 140,000 chunks; on a 4-core CPU it can take close to an hour; /chunky pause stops it).
hlotimizacao.tela.ajuste_jei: JEI took %s s to start: see the Warnings tab
hlotimizacao.tela.ajuste_jei_dica: tooltipSearchMode = DISABLED in config/jei/jei-client.ini skips building the tooltip index of every item.
